senses.gloss:
Jonarāja
of Kashmir; son of Nonarāja an. grandson of Laularāja; preceptor of Śrīvara (a. of Jainataraṅgiṇī, Weber 566); died in 1459 A. D.; Sbhv. 604. 621. 3038.
--C. on Kirātārjunīya. composed in 1449 A. D. See NCC. IV. p. 162a.
--Pādaprakaraṇasaṅgati. gr. topical analysis of the Kātantrasūtras.
Pt.. in S. K. Belvalkar's Systems of Skt. Gr. p.. 118-20.
--C. on Pṛthvīrājavijaya. BORI. 150 of 1875-76 (given a. a. of text). Report X.
--Rājataraṅgiṇī also called Rājāvalī; continuation of Kalhaṇa's work upto the reign of Zain-ul-'ābidīn (1417-67 [Page318-b] A. D.). BORI. D. XIII. ii. 619. IO. 7202.
--C. on Śrīkaṇṭhacarita of Maṅkha. BORI. D. XIII. ii. 767. IO. 3849.
Pt.. K. M. 3 (1887).
